statement: This sketch creates a dreamlike scene of whimsical paper-cut ships drifting across a waterlogged landscape. Each vessel is rendered with vibrant colors and visible signs of aging—tears, warping, and water damage that give them a fragile, distressed appearance. The ships float steadily at their own pace, responding subtly to mouse movement by altering their path slightly, creating an interactive yet serene atmosphere. The visual style emphasizes delicate, hand-crafted details within the constraints of computational art, evoking both nostalgia and a sense of gentle decay.
